name: jengo/storage
description: Modern, unified filesystem abstraction, asset management, and image pipeline for CodeIgniter 4 and the Jengo Framework.

suggest.ext-gd: Required for image manipulation when Imagick is not installed
suggest.ext-imagick: Recommended for advanced image manipulation and vector formats
suggest.jengo/schema: Required for building automatic file attachment and asset relations in database schema models

scripts.pre-install-cmd:
@php -r "if (!extension_loaded('gd') && !extension_loaded('imagick')) { fwrite(STDERR, 'jengo/storage requires either the GD (ext-gd) or Imagick (ext-imagick) PHP extension to be enabled.
'); exit(1); }"
scripts.pre-update-cmd:
@php -r "if (!extension_loaded('gd') && !extension_loaded('imagick')) { fwrite(STDERR, 'jengo/storage requires either the GD (ext-gd) or Imagick (ext-imagick) PHP extension to be enabled.
'); exit(1); }"
